aws.details: BitVector SMT reachability on Security Groups (sg_encoder.py) and BMC SMT reachability over IAM trust graph (reachability_encoder.py).

azure.details: BitVector SMT evaluation of NSG rules with RFC1918 scoping (azure_nsg_encoder.py) and RBAC scope hierarchy reachability (azure_trust_graph.py).

gcp.details: 32-bit BitVector SMT constraints over Compute Firewall rules (gcp_firewall_encoder.py) and Service Account token impersonation chains (gcp_trust_graph.py).

aws.details: Bounded Model Checking over dual-policy IAM trust graph detecting multi-hop sts:AssumeRole escalation paths.

azure.details: Models Azure RBAC role assignments, custom definitions, and hierarchical scope inheritance (Management Group -> Subscription -> Resource Group).

gcp.details: Models Service Account TokenCreator 2/3-hop impersonation chains and GKE Workload Identity federation with cycle detection.

aws.details: Subset-minimal AST deletion repair for Security Groups and IAM policies/privilege escalation (SG_OVER_EXPOSURE, IAM_WILDCARD_ALLOW, PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_REACHABILITY).

azure.details: Supported for azurerm_network_security_group NSG rules (NSG_OVER_EXPOSURE). Not supported for ARM JSON, Azure Governance Policy, or RBAC privilege escalation.

gcp.details: No repair engine implemented for GCP Compute Firewall rules or GCP IAM bindings (unhandled in solver/repair.py).

aws.details: Validating admission webhook intercepts ConfigMaps with AWS Terraform HCL and verifies SMT invariants with fail-closed timeout.

azure.details: Supported for Terraform HCL configurations containing azurerm resources in ConfigMaps; ARM JSON templates are unsupported as webhook only ingests .tf files.

gcp.details: Supported for Terraform HCL configurations containing GCP Compute Firewall and IAM resources in ConfigMaps.
